findings.summary: Duplicate text output in streaming mode (the default): raw delta events print incremental text, then the message_output_item RunItemStreamEvent prints the same full text again via ItemHelpers.text_message_output
findings.failure_scenario: Any streaming REPL session (the default since stream=True) prints every agent response twice -- once character-by-character from ResponseTextDeltaEvent deltas (line 47), and again as the full assembled message when the message_output_item event arrives (line 54). The user sees garbled duplicate output for every turn.

findings.summary: No exception handling around Runner.run_streamed() or Runner.run() -- any agent exception (MaxTurnsExceeded, guardrail tripwires, ModelBehaviorError, etc.) crashes the entire REPL instead of printing an error and continuing the loop
findings.failure_scenario: After 10 conversation turns with the default max_turns, a MaxTurnsExceeded exception is raised -- it propagates uncaught out of the while-loop, crashes the REPL, and discards all conversation state. Same behavior for guardrail tripwires or any other AgentsException.

findings.summary: Whitespace-only input (e.g. spaces, tabs) bypasses the empty-input guard because 'if not user_input' checks the raw string, while the exit check uses strip().lower() -- result: a whitespace-only content message is sent to the agent
findings.failure_scenario: User types three spaces and presses Enter. user_input = '   '. '   '.strip().lower() = '' which is not in {'exit', 'quit'}, so the exit check does not break. 'not "   "' is False, so the empty-input guard does not trigger. The loop proceeds to append {'role': 'user', 'content': '   '} to input_items and sends a whitespace-only message to the model.
